Agent review of name, domain, type, fetched collection/product signal counts and matched product titles; not live page visits
method: Inputs: three part CSVs (shopify 5,705; other 1,480; discovery 114) read via git show from the part branches.

Dedupe key: registrable domain via tldextract (PSL private domains on); domains hosting 5+ merchants (bigcartel, square.site, 3dcartstores, ecwid, etc.) keyed by full host so merchant subdomains stay distinct. Winner = strongest verification rank, then richest row; stored URL/path (incl. locale paths) kept as-is.

Gender: Shopify rows -> /collections.json handles+titles, then /products.json titles/product_type/tags; non-Shopify rows -> homepage anchor hrefs/text. Tokens women/womens/ladies/her/female vs men/mens/him/guys; unisex/genderless/all-gender explicit.

Unisex only when both sides present (>=2 signals each, minor side >=8% of gendered signals) or explicit unisex (a unisex collection, or >=3 unisex products and >=15% share). No signal -> store-name signal -> previous Women/Men value kept -> otherwise Unspecified (never default Unisex).

Fetching: curl, global adaptive limiter 4-8 req/s (starts 6, -25% on 429, +0.5 per 100 clean responses), 429 exponential backoff with retries, robots.txt fetched per host and honoured, no challenge bypass (403/captcha pages are recorded as failures and the old value is kept).

Sanity pass: name/domain rules for kids-only, marketplaces/resale/big-box wholesale clubs, B2B wholesale, non-fashion (supplements, pets, CBD...), shoes/bags/jewelry/hats/socks/print-shop-only names. Generic scraped names (My Site, Access denied...) replaced by domain label.
gaps: Gender is Unspecified for ~29% of rows: many boutiques and merch stores do not label collections/products by gender; product-type keyword inference (dress, bra) was not applied.
Non-Shopify gender relies on homepage nav only; JS-rendered sites (Square, Wix, Bigcartel) mostly returned no nav, so those rows keep prior values or become Unspecified.
Fetch failures (403/404/timeouts/robots) keep the old gender value (counted under Gender basis); some old values were default Unisex.
The discovery part has no excluded CSV (summary only), so its exclusions are not in the Excluded sheet.
Type (Fashion-only vs Has clothing section) is inherited from the parts and was not re-derived; merch stores with a few tees can be labelled Fashion-only.
Kids/marketplace/non-fashion filtering in the sanity pass is name/domain based, so kids-only stores with neutral names may remain.
Size Tier and Platform are inherited; platform labels normalised to lowercase.
